name: databricks-sql-quickcheck
description: Instant, as-you-type structural syntax checks for Databricks SQL: brackets, quotes, commas, operators, CASE/END.

databricksSqlQuickcheck.enable.description: Check SQL files as you type.

databricksSqlQuickcheck.warnings.description: Also report likely mistakes that Databricks may technically accept: a missing comma in a select list, a trailing comma before FROM, an unknown statement keyword.

databricksSqlQuickcheck.explicitAliases.description: Warn on every implicit column alias (SELECT a b). Off by default because about one real file in ten aliases this way on purpose; turn it on if your team already requires AS, and every lost comma in a select list is reported.

scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && vsce package --no-rewrite-relative-links -o dist/databricks-sql-quickcheck.vsix
